text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Filling in Hunan University of TCM Application Form for admission application.doc 6. Certification of no crime 7. 20 pictures of 2-inch size, 10 pictures of 1-inch size （on a white background）
